# Checkov check IDs held at ZERO failures on lambdas/Dockerfile (the dockerfile-framework scan in
# security.yml).
#
# THIS FILE IS THE GATE, and it is the same shape as .github/checkov-enforced.txt for the same
# reason: a gate blocks on a NARROWED count, never a total. `GATE_CHECKOV=block` fails the job
# when any check listed here reports a failure; every other dockerfile finding is published and
# does not block. The reasoning is in .github/scripts/checkov-enforced.sh, which evaluates both
# lists.
#
# THE CRITERION IS "PASSES TODAY", NOT "MATTERS MOST" — the rule the terraform list states, kept
# here so the two are not argued separately. Every ID below was measured at zero failures against
# checkov 3.3.9 on 2026-09-01 (38 passed / 2 failed on this Dockerfile). Turning them on cost no
# remediation.
#
# THE TWO FAILURES ARE NOT SUPPRESSED. Both are dispositioned in docs/security-baseline.md, and
# both are properties of what a Lambda container IS rather than of how this one is written:
#   * CKV_DOCKER_2 (no HEALTHCHECK) — Lambda never runs a Docker health check. The Runtime API
#     contract is the health signal, and an image declaring one would be declaring something
#     nothing reads.
#   * CKV_DOCKER_3 (no USER)        — the AWS-published base image sets none, and Lambda's
#     isolation boundary is the execution environment rather than the container user.
#
# SCOPED TO THIS DOCKERFILE. apps/portal/Dockerfile is scanned by nothing, here or elsewhere, and
# that gap is recorded in docs/security-baseline.md rather than closed here: it PASSES
# CKV_DOCKER_3 (it sets USER 101) while this image cannot, so one shared list would have to drop
# that check and could never enforce it for the SPA. Covering both wants a list per Dockerfile,
# which is a widening this spec deliberately did not take on.

CKV_DOCKER_5    # Ensure update instructions are not used alone in the Dockerfile
CKV_DOCKER_7    # Ensure the base image uses a non-latest version tag
CKV_DOCKER_9    # Ensure that APT is not used
CKV_DOCKER_11   # Ensure that base images use a non-latest, digest-pinned reference
CKV2_DOCKER_1   # Ensure that sudo is not used
CKV2_DOCKER_2   # Ensure that certificate validation is not disabled with wget
CKV2_DOCKER_3   # Ensure that certificate validation is not disabled with curl
CKV2_DOCKER_4   # Ensure that certificate validation is not disabled with pip
CKV2_DOCKER_5   # Ensure that certificate validation is not disabled with npm
CKV2_DOCKER_6   # Ensure that certificate validation is not disabled with yum
CKV2_DOCKER_7   # Ensure that certificate validation is not disabled with apt-get
CKV2_DOCKER_8   # Ensure that certificate validation is not disabled with rpm
CKV2_DOCKER_9   # Ensure that GPG check is not disabled with yum
CKV2_DOCKER_10  # Ensure that GPG check is not disabled with rpm
CKV2_DOCKER_11  # Ensure that GPG check is not disabled with dnf
CKV2_DOCKER_12  # Ensure that certificate validation is not disabled with dnf
CKV2_DOCKER_13  # Ensure that certificate validation is not disabled with apk
CKV2_DOCKER_14  # Ensure that certificate validation is not disabled with gem
CKV2_DOCKER_15  # Ensure that certificate validation is not disabled with composer
CKV2_DOCKER_16  # Ensure that certificate validation is not disabled with go
CKV2_DOCKER_17  # Ensure that certificate validation is not disabled with cargo
